option.name: -a
tip: Bind the agent to the UNIX socket at the given address.
The default is a random socket path in ~/.ssh/agent.

option.name: -A
tip: Create the agent socket in a different directory.
A path prefixed with user: is a user-specific directory relative to ~.

option.name: -c
tip: Generate C-shell commands on standard output.
This is the default for csh-style shells.

option.name: -d
tip: Debug mode.
Do not fork, and write debug information to standard error.

option.name: -D
tip: Foreground mode.
ssh-agent will not fork.

option.name: -E
tip: Specify the hash algorithm used when displaying key fingerprints.
Possible values: md5, sha256
The default is sha256.

option.name: -k
tip: Kill the current agent given by the SSH_AGENT_PID environment variable.

option.name: -O
tip: Specify an option when starting the agent.
Possible values: allow-remote-pkcs11, no-restrict-websafe, websafe-allow

option.name: -P
tip: Specify a pattern-list of acceptable paths for PKCS#11 and FIDO middleware libraries.
Libraries that do not match are refused.

option.name: -s
tip: Generate Bourne shell commands on standard output.
This is the default for non-csh shells.

option.name: -t
tip: Set a default maximum lifetime for identities added to the agent.
The lifetime is in seconds or in a time format from sshd_config(5).

option.name: -T
tip: Bind the agent socket in a randomized temporary subdirectory.

option.name: -u
tip: Clean up stale agent sockets under ~/.ssh/agent/ and exit immediately.

option.name: -U
tip: Do not clean up stale agent sockets under ~/.ssh/agent/.

option.name: -V
tip: Display the version number and exit.
